info.title: DD Monitor API
info.description:
Backend of the DD regulatory monitoring platform (steps 0 to 18).

Flow: Upload, poll Progress every 1 to 2 seconds until the run is finished, Draft, Confirm
(embedding and cleanup then run as a background job; Progress shows it), Profile, Update,
Audit. Legal sources: upload a PDF (a job), list them. Screening: start a job, poll it,
read the company's matches. Alerts: list, open, mark seen or dismiss; preview the email,
edit the template, send the confirmed email, read the outreach history.

Long work answers 202 with a job (`Location: /api/jobs/{id}`); poll it. Failed or
interrupted jobs are retried explicitly; Recover selects the work from the project state.
Nothing is resumed automatically after a restart. Calendar is not part of the platform.
Ids are opaque. No authentication (single user).

Every error has the shape `{code, message, details, error_id, outreach_id}`. Codes:
`law_terms_found`, `status_locked`, `not_allowed`, `unresolved_fields`, `validation_error`, `validation`, `bad_request`, `empty_upload`, `upload_too_large`, `not_found`, `wrong_state`, `stale_draft`, `stale_profile`, `busy`, `run_active`, `duplicate`, `send_pending`, `already_sent`, `send_failed`, `mail_unavailable`, `llm_unavailable`, `publish_failed`, `not_supported`, `database_unavailable`, `method_not_allowed`, `internal_error`.

post.summary: Upload a data room and start the run
post.description:
Stores every file below a new company folder (relative paths kept), creates the
company id and starts the run in the background. Unsupported file types are accepted and
reported later as unsupported; unsafe paths, duplicates and files over a limit are
rejected one by one with a reason. Poll Progress every 1 to 2 seconds.

get.summary: The profile draft for review, with sources and evidence quotes
get.description:
Fields with status, candidate groups with sources and evidence quotes (untrusted
document text: render as plain text), needs-review flags, non-binding suggestions, list
rows, the draft version, the open decisions and the open hints. Only in state
published after a finished run.

post.summary: Confirm the profile with the advisor's decisions
post.description:
All or nothing. Every open decision of the Draft call needs one decision (nothing
is pre-selected). Problems come back per field (code validation); a newer draft answers
stale_draft. On success embedding and cleanup start in the background.

get.summary: The confirmed profile with citations and its version
get.description:
Values with their citation (file and page in `fundstelle`, the cited document in
`quelle`; advisor-entered values say so instead), the profile version needed by Update,
the "embeddings stale" flag and the audit log. Never evidence quotes or conflict
alternatives.

post.summary: Update entries of a confirmed profile
post.description:
All or nothing; there is no undo (ask "are you sure" first). Refused before
confirmation (wrong_state), while a step or job of the company runs (busy) and on a
stale profile version (stale_profile); invalid values come back per field. The vectors
are refreshed by a background job (then, with SCREEN_AFTER_UPDATE, the changes are
re-screened); Progress shows the job and "embeddings stale" until then. A contact
address edit needs neither.

post.summary: Upload one legal source (PDF) and start its ingestion
post.description:
Stores the PDF under a generated name, then parses, describes, splits and embeds it
in the background. The same content twice is refused (duplicate) unless `replace`.
Poll the job; its result is the ingest report with the new law id.

post.summary: Start screening (one or every company, one or every law)
post.description:
Reconciles every earlier decision in scope; unchanged judge inputs reuse their
verdict (no LLM call); at most the configured number of sections is judged per
execution, the rest is reported as deferred (start another screening). `dry_run`
stops after scoring and changes nothing. Poll the job for the reports.

post.summary: Send the confirmed email (exactly these values)
post.description:
Needs `confirmed=true`. The send guard is checked again while the pending record is
reserved. Errors: send_pending (unresolved earlier attempt or uncertain delivery,
with outreach_id), already_sent, send_failed (502, a new send may follow),
mail_unavailable (503).

post.summary: Retry a failed or interrupted job (a new attempt)
post.description:

post.summary: Finish interrupted or failed work after confirmation
post.description:
Selects the work from the current state: confirmed -> embed and clean up; stale
vectors -> rebuild them (and clean up if needed); embedded -> clean up; cleaned ->
nothing, unless files are left or configured screening is pending. Answers 202 with
the job, or 200 without one when there is nothing to do. Never repeats the
confirmation and never sends an email; before confirmation use rerun.

AppliedDecision.title: AppliedDecision
AppliedDecision.description: An advisor decision applied to a draft field; set only on the confirmed draft.

files.title: Files
files.description: every file of the DD folder (repeat the field once per file)

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: relative path of each file, same order as `files` (for example 'Steuern/Bescheide/KSt 2022.pdf'); without it the file name of each part is used

project_name.title: Project Name
project_name.description: optional project name; the company id is made from it

file.title: File
file.description: the legal source as one PDF

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: replace a stored source with the same content

CalendarEntry.title: CalendarEntry
CalendarEntry.description: One sent email on the calendar, with the client's reply once recorded.

CandidateGroup.title: CandidateGroup
CandidateGroup.description:
Candidates that count as the same value. `value` is the most precise member
(for list items: the most complete one, gaps filled from the other members).

CellChoice.title: CellChoice
CellChoice.description: One cell of a list row: take it from a candidate group, or type it. Exactly one.

ConfirmedProfile.title: ConfirmedProfile
ConfirmedProfile.description: Read side after confirmation: values, citations, version and the audit log.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: The advisor's choice for one scalar field or one list row.

DecisionAction.title: DecisionAction
DecisionAction.description: What the advisor decided for one field or list row (step 8).

DocumentCitation.title: DocumentCitation
DocumentCitation.description: The `dokument` row a value cites: the advisor re-checks it in their own copy.

HintRow.title: HintRow
HintRow.description: An open `pruefhinweis` row of the company (profil schema).

Invalidation.title: Invalidation

Job.title: Job
Job.description: A background job (screening run, embedding, refresh) the UI polls.

JobView.title: JobView
JobView.description: What the API returns: no server paths, credentials or vectors.

OpenDecision.title: OpenDecision
OpenDecision.description: Something the advisor must decide before the profile can be confirmed.

Processing.title: Processing
Processing.description:
Background work of one client after confirmation: what runs, what failed, and
whether "Verarbeitung abschließen" (recover) would start something.

ProfileRow.title: ProfileRow
ProfileRow.description: A row of the confirmed profile with its citation (never an evidence quote).

ProjectState.title: ProjectState
ProjectState.description: Moves forward one step at a time; a failed step leaves it unchanged.

Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.description: An automatic comparison; original candidates remain available for review.

ReviewView.title: ReviewView
ReviewView.description: Everything the review screen reads; no extraction happens here.

ScreeningStatus.title: ScreeningStatus
ScreeningStatus.description: Is screening of the company up to date? Shown in Progress.

SectionView.title: SectionView
SectionView.description: A law section without its vector.

SendBody.title: SendBody
SendBody.description: The final values from the UI; the backend sends exactly these.

UpdateBody.title: UpdateBody
UpdateBody.description: Changes to a confirmed profile (edit, add, remove, end).

app__api__schemas__ConfirmBody.title: ConfirmBody
app__api__schemas__ConfirmBody.description: The advisor's final choice per open decision (see the Draft call).

app__models__audit__AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
app__models__audit__AuditEntry.description: A row of `pipeline.audit_log`. `id` and `acted_at` are set by the database.

app__models__extraction__Candidate.title: Candidate
app__models__extraction__Candidate.description: One value for one field from one document: a row of `field_candidates`.

app__models__match__Match.title: Match
app__models__match__Match.description: A row of `screening.match`: one judged pair per company and law section.
